Key.description: The key identifier, or name, of the tag.

Value.description: The string value that's associated with the key of the tag. You can set the value of a tag to an empty string, but you can't set the value of a tag to null.

AccountId.description: If the account was created successfully, the unique identifier (ID) of the new account.

AccountName.description: The friendly name of the member account.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the account.

Email.description: The email address of the owner to assign to the new member account.

JoinedMethod.description: The method by which the account joined the organization.

JoinedTimestamp.description: The date the account became a part of the organization.

ParentIds.description: List of parent nodes for the member account. Currently only one parent at a time is supported. Default is root.

Paths.description: The paths in the organization where the account exists.

RoleName.description: The name of an IAM role that AWS Organizations automatically preconfigures in the new member account. Default name is OrganizationAccountAccessRole if not specified.

State.description: The state of the account in the organization.

Status.description: The status of the account in the organization.

Tags.description: A list of tags that you want to attach to the newly created account. For each tag in the list, you must specify both a tag key and a value.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of an organization.

FeatureSet.description: Specifies the feature set supported by the new organization. Each feature set supports different levels of functionality.

Id.description: The unique identifier (ID) of an organization.

ManagementAccountArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the account that is designated as the management account for the organization.

ManagementAccountEmail.description: The email address that is associated with the AWS account that is designated as the management account for the organization.

ManagementAccountId.description: The unique identifier (ID) of the management account of an organization.

RootId.description: The unique identifier (ID) for the root.

Value.description: The string value that's associated with the key of the tag. You can set the value of a tag to an empty string, but you can't set the value of a tag to null.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of this OU.

Id.description: The unique identifier (ID) associated with this OU.

Name.description: The friendly name of this OU.

ParentId.description: The unique identifier (ID) of the parent root or OU that you want to create the new OU in.

Path.description: The path in the organization where this OU exists.

Tags.description: A list of tags that you want to attach to the newly created OU.

Value.description: The string value that's associated with the key of the tag. You can set the value of a tag to an empty string, but you can't set the value of a tag to null.

AwsManaged.description: A boolean value that indicates whether the specified policy is an AWS managed policy. If true, then you can attach the policy to roots, OUs, or accounts, but you cannot edit it.

Content.description: The Policy text content. For AWS CloudFormation templates formatted in YAML, you can provide the policy in JSON or YAML format. AWS CloudFormation always converts a YAML policy to JSON format before submitting it.

Description.description: Human readable description of the policy

Tags.description: A list of tags that you want to attach to the newly created policy. For each tag in the list, you must specify both a tag key and a value. You can set the value to an empty string, but you can't set it to null.

TargetIds.description: List of unique identifiers (IDs) of the root, OU, or account that you want to attach the policy to

Type.description: The type of policy to create. You can specify one of the following values: AISERVICES_OPT_OUT_POLICY, BACKUP_POLICY, BEDROCK_POLICY, CHATBOT_POLICY, DECLARATIVE_POLICY_EC2, GUARDDUTY_POLICY, INSPECTOR_POLICY, NETWORK_SECURITY_DIRECTOR_POLICY, RESOURCE_CONTROL_POLICY, S3_POLICY, SECURITYHUB_POLICY, SERVICE_CONTROL_POLICY, TAG_POLICY, UPGRADE_ROLLOUT_POLICY

Content.description: The policy document. For AWS CloudFormation templates formatted in YAML, you can provide the policy in JSON or YAML format. AWS CloudFormation always converts a YAML policy to JSON format before submitting it.

Id.description: The unique identifier (ID) associated with this resource policy.

Tags.description: A list of tags that you want to attach to the resource policy

Value.description: The string value associated with the key of the tag.

ManagementAccountEmail.description: The email address of the participant's management account.

ManagementAccountId.description: The ID of the participant's management account.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the transfer as seen by the calling account, whose own account, organization and transfer direction the ARN carries. This resource type models the inbound view, in which the calling account is the transfer's Target, so the direction segment is always inbound; an outbound ARN identifies a resource of a different type.

EndTimestamp.description: The date and time at which the transfer ended. Present once the transfer has been terminated; the service writes it on that transition and retains the record.

Id.description: The unique identifier (ID) of the transfer.

Name.description: The name assigned to the transfer.

OrganizationId.description: The unique identifier (ID) of the calling account's organization, as it appears in the transfer ARN.

StartTimestamp.description: The time at which the transfer starts.

Tags.description: A list of tags attached to the transfer.

Type.description: The type of responsibility the transfer designates.

Status.description: The status of the policy type as it relates to the associated root.

Type.description: The name of the policy type.

Key.description: The key identifier of the tag.

Value.description: The string value associated with the key of the tag.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the root.

Id.description: The unique identifier (ID) for the root.

Name.description: The friendly name of the root.

OrganizationId.description: The unique identifier (ID) of the organization that contains this root.

PolicyTypes.description: The types of policies currently enabled for the root.

Tags.description: A list of tags attached to the root.
